SELECT
    u.Id AS UserId,
    u.DisplayName AS UserDisplayName,
    comment_counts.CommentCount,
    b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.UserId,
        COUNT(*) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.UserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.UserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MAX(cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM comments
            WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY UserId
        ) AS counts
    )
) AS comment_counts
JOIN users u ON u.Id = comment_counts.UserId
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
ORDER BY u.DisplayName, b.Name
